profile: LuaHBTeX shipout-time intervals around navigation and URL macros

measurement.method: A temporary source inserted paired LuaTeX latelua markers around each gfbpagelink, gfbanchor, and bookurl output. os.clock accumulated CPU intervals when pages shipped. Three direct single-pass compiles reused the same isolated output directory; no production source was modified.
limitations: The intervals include page composition and PDF annotation work between markers; they are not pure macro-expansion timings.
The profile covers one synthetic N=100 fixture without portraits, not a full production build.
The instrumented PDF is diagnostic only and was not retained in the repository.
LateLua marker nodes can alter link fragmentation; annotation and structure counts below come from separate uninstrumented baseline/candidate PDFs.

single_nolinkurl_candidate.change: Use one nolinkurl call for the visible host+path within the existing full href target.

pdf.text_difference: The unfiltered extracted text order changes where a page header meets a wrapped URL; after removing running headers and whitespace, the content hash matches the baseline.

visual_review.finding: The visible URL line breaks after slash and no longer divides register between reg and ister.

single_nolinkurl_candidate.decision: Retained as a URL readability change; no performance claim.
single_nolinkurl_candidate.profile_runs_basis: Instrumented marker source; counts and timing describe macro intervals, while PDF structure results are from separate uninstrumented sources.

encoded_url_qualification.limitation: Escaping-only diagnostic; full-book convergence was not required for this URI check.

decision: Retained as a URL readability change; no end-to-end performance claim.
